name: NTC 2018 — Italian Structural Code
description: Validates structural project documentation against the Norme Tecniche per le Costruzioni (NTC 2018, D.M. 17 gennaio 2018) and its explanatory circular (Circolare 21/01/2019 n. 7). Checks seismic zone classification, soil category, structural material specifications, load combinations, and that the relazione di calcolo (structural report) covers the required chapters.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
regulator: Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti
